title: Publish the project
details: The repository is public at github.com/codesweep-ai/npmrevs, and main is pushed. What remains, in order. Set Settings > Pages > Source to GitHub Actions: pages.yml fails on every run until it is. Publish the five packages once by hand, with npm/publish.sh from a machine logged in to npm, because npm names a trusted publisher only for a package that exists. Name npm.yml as the trusted publisher of each of the five, and set each package to require two-factor authentication and disallow tokens. Make each of the five ghcr.io packages public, and add the project to the CI dashboard. Tag v0.1.0, publish the draft release goreleaser leaves behind, and run make npm-publish so the release takes the latest tag: the npm workflow publishes dev builds only. The move-to-npmrevs branches of lint, ledger and ui can merge once the module resolves from GitHub.
